subject: MAP: ClearSky Financial – deployment mode & region decision (next steps)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@clearskyfin.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: ClearSky Financial – deployment mode & region decision (next steps)

Hi Ellen / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great alignment on the acceptance criteria and the eval plan. Attached is an updated MAP (v3) that folds in the performance targets (p50 < 120ms for embeddings lookup, p95 < 350ms for chat path) and the go/no-go gates for security review.

Two decision points we need from your side to finalize the MAP and move to procurement:
- Deployment mode: Hosted (fastest path, shared infra) vs Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) vs Private (VPC / on-prem).
- Primary region: EU (recommended: eu-west-1) vs US.

High-level tradeoffs:
- Hosted: quickest to prod (~2 weeks), lower procurement friction, but shared-colocated data path.
- Dedicated: predictable throughput and SLAs, 4–6 week lead for capacity provisioning.
- Private: full network isolation + KMS/HSM integration, 6–10 week procurement + onboarding (depends on your infra team).

If you can confirm which mode + region you prefer, I’ll update the MAP milestone dates and circulate an SOW draft for procurement. I’ve attached our SOC2 summary as requested — more detailed evidence is available on the compliance portal (link below).

Next actionable items I propose:
1) You confirm preferred mode + region by Friday 9/17.
2) We deliver SOW draft and pricing addendum within 48 hours of that confirmation.
3) Kickoff for legal/procurement alignment the week of 9/27.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

- Procurement asked that we get an SOW and a draft contract to start legal review — they want to aim for a signed contract by 10/01 if possible.

Can we confirm:
1) Private deployment lead time to be fully operational in eu-west-1 (including KMS/HSM integration + onboarding windows).
2) Any caveats for supporting their network team (we’ll likely need an RFC for peering and service endpoint IPs).
3) Pricing posture for a private deployment (baseline capacity assumptions: 2x A100 class nodes equivalent, expected steady QPS ~45 req/s, burst to 120 req/s).

I’ll bundle your answers into the SOW draft.

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: ClearSky Financial – deployment mode & region decision (next steps)

Priya —

Short answers:
1) Private (VPC) in eu-west-1: 6–8 week lead time assuming standard procurement cadence. That includes provisioning, onboarding, and KMS integration validation. If we can run a parallel staging in Dedicated for initial functional tests, we can shave ~2–3 weeks off the net time to customer-facing acceptance.

2) Network: we will need their infra team to allow our provisioning CIDR and accept a small set of egress IPs. I’ll prepare a one-page RFC (IP ranges, ports, CIDR allowances) — target by EOD 9/15.

3) Pricing: for the capacity profile you noted, estimate (ballpark) a monthly committed fee + one-time onboarding. I’ll get precise numbers and a pricing table for SOW tomorrow.

Notes: KMS/HSM — we support customer-managed keys (KMS) integrations; HSMs require additional FIPS/HW attestations and typically extend the lead time (~+2 weeks). If they need HSM-backed keys in their HSM, we’ll map that into the SOW with optional tasks.

—Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Ruiz <ellen.ruiz@clearskyfin.com>, Tom Harrington <tom.harrington@clearskyfin.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@clearskyfin.com>, procurement@clearskyfin.com

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: ClearSky Financial – deployment mode & region decision (next steps)

Ellen —

Thanks for the preference. Confirming the ask and next materials:
- We’ll target Private (VPC) in eu-west-1.
- Karthik estimates 6–8 week lead time; HSM would add ~2 weeks if you require it.
- Attached: SOW_draft_CSF_v1.docx (scope, milestones, acceptance criteria), MAP_ClearSky_v3.xlsx, SOC2_report_Redwood_2025.pdf.

Procurement: once you accept the SOW scope, we’ll generate the commercial schedule and a contract redline for your legal. If your internal target is 10/01 sign, realistically we should aim to have the SOW and commercial schedule finalized by 9/20 to give legal two full weeks for review.

Open items for your team to confirm:
1) KMS only vs KMS + HSM (affects lead time & optional tasks).
2) Preferred provisioning model: Redwood manages onboarding into your VPC (recommended) OR we provide a runbook for in-house provisioning (longer timeline).
3) Any specific regulatory controls beyond SOC2 we should include in appendix (PCI, GDPR data processing addendum, DPA comments).

I’ll follow up with an updated milestone table in the MAP with the 6–8 week onboarding path and a parallel Dedicated staging option to accelerate early validation.

Best —
Priya

Priya / Karthik —

Thanks for the clarity. ClearSky confirms:
- Mode: Private (VPC) deployed to eu-west-1.

- Procurement timeline: target signature 2026-10-01; procurement@clearskyfin.com will accept your SOW draft and commercial schedule for redline.

Procurement note: please send the SOW + pricing schedule and a top-line contract for redline by COB Monday 9/20. Also include a short implementation plan (network RFC + onboarding checklist).

We’ll plan a technical kickoff the week of 10/04.

Ellen
